notes: trae-cli 0.1.0 (commit e839e55, 2026-02): no product header, only the openai-python or anthropic-python SDK defaults, so identity ('You are an expert AI software engineering agent.\n\nFile Path Rule…') and the 4-tool set carry the verdict; the LiteLLM-only x-stainless-raw-response header is a deny feature against Aider and OpenHands. The same CLI speaks the Responses API (provider openai), chat completions (provider openrouter) and the Anthropic messages API (provider anthropic), hence family 'any'; never streams, temperature 0.5 and top_p 1 from the config. After a text answer it sends 'It seems that you have not completed the task.' as the user until a done phrase or max_steps; the interactive mode appends a second system+user pair for a real follow-up.
